mcqs.question: Under which article of the Constitution of Pakistan (1973) is the Council of Common Interests (CCI) established?
mcqs.explanation: Article 153 of the 1973 Constitution provides for the constitution and composition of the Council of Common Interests (CCI), which resolves provincial-federal disputes.

mcqs.question: The Lucknow Pact of December 1916 was signed jointly by the All India Muslim League and the Indian National Congress primarily due to the efforts of:
mcqs.explanation: Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah was titled the "Ambassador of Hindu-Muslim Unity" by Sarojini Naidu for orchestrating the historic Lucknow Pact of 1916.

mcqs.question: Which constitutional amendment in Pakistan abolished the Concurrent Legislative List and granted comprehensive provincial autonomy?
mcqs.explanation: The 18th Constitutional Amendment passed in April 2010 devolved 17 federal ministries to the provinces and abolished the Concurrent Legislative List.

mcqs.question: The Objectives Resolution was passed by the first Constituent Assembly of Pakistan on:
mcqs.explanation: Prime Minister Liaquat Ali Khan moved the historic Objectives Resolution on March 7, 1949, and it was adopted on March 12, 1949 as the foundation of Pakistan constitutional framework.

mcqs.question: Under the Indus Waters Treaty (1960) brokered by the World Bank, exclusive rights over the three Western Rivers were allocated to Pakistan. These rivers are:
mcqs.explanation: The treaty allocated the three eastern rivers (Ravi, Beas, Sutlej) to India and the three western rivers (Indus, Jhelum, Chenab) to Pakistan.

mcqs.question: Which layer of the atmosphere contains the highest concentration of ozone that shields the Earth from harmful ultraviolet radiation?
mcqs.explanation: The ozone layer is primarily situated in the stratosphere, approximately 15 to 35 kilometers above Earth surface.

mcqs.question: Deficiency of Vitamin D in human adults leads to which clinical bone condition?
mcqs.explanation: While Vitamin D deficiency causes Rickets in young growing children, in adults it causes Osteomalacia (softening of the bones).

mcqs.question: A train 180 meters long is travelling at 54 km/h. How many seconds will it take to pass an electric pole completely?
mcqs.explanation: Speed in m/s = 54 * (5/18) = 15 m/s. Time to pass a point pole = Distance / Speed = 180 / 15 = 12 seconds.

mcqs.question: Find the next term in the alphanumeric series: B2D, D4F, F8H, H16J, ?
mcqs.explanation: First letters advance by +2 (B, D, F, H -> J). Numbers double each step (2, 4, 8, 16 -> 32). Third letters advance by +2 (D, F, H, J -> L). Hence, J32L.

mcqs.question: Select the most appropriate antonym for the word "OBSEQUIOUS":
mcqs.explanation: Obsequious means excessively compliant or submissive. Its direct opposite is assertive, bold, or independent.

mcqs.question: Choose the correct meaning of the foreign phrase "Prima Facie":
mcqs.explanation: Prima Facie is a Latin expression meaning "at first face" or "based on first impression / at first sight".

mcqs.question: Identify the sentence with the correct subjunctive mood usage:
options: The board demanded that he resign immediately.
The board demanded that he resigns immediately.
The board demanded that he will resign immediately.
The board demanded that he must resign immediately.
mcqs.explanation: In mandative subjunctive clauses following verbs like demand, insist, recommend, the bare infinitive without -s (resign) is required.

mcqs.question: The Treaty of Hudaibiyah was signed in which Hijri year and who scribed the treaty terms on behalf of Muslims?
options: 5 AH, scribed by Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A)
8 AH, scribed by Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A)
mcqs.explanation: The Treaty of Hudaibiyah was formulated in 6 AH (628 CE) and Hazrat Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A) penned down the treaty clauses.

mcqs.question: The compilation of the Holy Quran in book form (Mushaf) was initiated during the caliphate of which Rightly Guided Caliph upon the advice of Hazrat Umar (R.A)?
mcqs.explanation: Following the Battle of Yamama where numerous Huffaz attained martyrdom, Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) entrusted Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A) with compiling the initial manuscript.

mcqs.question: How many categories of eligible recipients for Zakat (Masarif-e-Zakat) are ordained explicitly in Surah At-Tawbah (Ayah 60)?
mcqs.explanation: Surah At-Tawbah verse 60 designates 8 distinct categories for Zakat distribution, including the poor (Fuqara), needy (Masakeen), and administrators of Zakat.

mcqs.question: The 23rd Meeting of the Council of Heads of Government of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) in October 2024 was hosted in:
mcqs.explanation: Pakistan held the rotating chairmanship and proudly hosted the 23rd SCO Council of Heads of Government summit in Islamabad on October 15-16, 2024.

mcqs.question: The United Nations Climate Change Conference COP28, where the historic Loss and Damage Fund was officially launched, took place in:
mcqs.explanation: COP28 took place at Expo City Dubai, United Arab Emirates, in December 2023, activating the Loss and Damage fund pivotal for vulnerable nations like Pakistan.

mcqs.question: Which strait separates the Arabian Peninsula from Iran and connects the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman?
mcqs.explanation: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world most critical chokepoints, connecting the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea.

mcqs.question: The historic Rohtas Fort situated near Jhelum was constructed during the reign of which emperor?
mcqs.explanation: Sher Shah Suri built the UNESCO World Heritage Rohtas Fort between 1541 and 1548 to subdue the rebellious Gakhar tribes of Potohar.

mcqs.question: Lake Baikal, the deepest and oldest freshwater lake in the world, is situated in which country?
mcqs.explanation: Lake Baikal is situated in southern Siberia, Russia, holding approximately 20% of the world unfrozen surface fresh water.

mcqs.question: Urdu ke mashhoor adbi risale "Makhzan" ke baani aur mudir kaun thay?
mcqs.explanation: Sir Abdul Qadir launched the prestigious literary journal "Makhzan" in April 1901 from Lahore, in which Allama Iqbal first published his historic poems.

mcqs.question: In Microsoft Excel, which keyboard shortcut key is used to edit the active cell directly?
mcqs.explanation: Pressing F2 in Microsoft Excel activates edit mode in the currently highlighted cell.

mcqs.question: Which network topology connects all nodes to a single central cable known as the backbone?
mcqs.explanation: Bus topology uses a single backbone transmission cable to which all network nodes and workstations are tapped.

mcqs.question: What is the standard length of an Olympic swimming pool in meters?
mcqs.explanation: An Olympic-size swimming pool is officially 50 meters in length, 25 meters in width, and at least 2 meters in depth.

mcqs.question: Sound waves cannot travel through which of the following media?
mcqs.explanation: Sound is a mechanical longitudinal wave requiring a material medium for propagation, and therefore cannot travel through a vacuum.

mcqs.question: The boundary commission appointed in 1947 for the demarcation of Punjab and Bengal was headed by:
mcqs.explanation: Sir Cyril Radcliffe, a British lawyer, was appointed chairman of the Punjab and Bengal Boundary Commissions.

mcqs.question: Choose the correct preposition: "The magistrate took cognizance _____ the complaint lodged by the citizen."
mcqs.explanation: The standard legal idiom is "to take cognizance OF" an offence or complaint.

mcqs.question: If 12 men can complete a civil works project in 18 days, how many men will be required to finish the same work in 8 days?
mcqs.explanation: Total man-days required = 12 * 18 = 216 man-days. Men required for 8 days = 216 / 8 = 27 men.

mcqs.question: What is the full form of IPv6, and how many bits does an IPv6 address consist of?
mcqs.explanation: IPv6 stands for Internet Protocol Version 6 and uses 128-bit addresses (compared to IPv4 32 bits).

mcqs.question: Which gas is predominantly responsible for the greenhouse effect on planet Venus, causing its extreme surface temperatures?
mcqs.explanation: Venus thick atmosphere consists of over 96% Carbon Dioxide, causing a runaway greenhouse effect and surface temperatures exceeding 460°C.

mcqs.question: Which Pakistani diplomat served as the President of the UN Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC) and actively represented the G77 plus China bloc?
mcqs.explanation: Ambassador Munir Akram has represented Pakistan as Permanent Representative to the UN in New York and served as President of ECOSOC.

pastPapers.title: CSS Competitive Examination 2025 — Pakistan Affairs (Compulsory)
pastPapers.description: Official verified curriculum structure and authentic exam questions from the CSS 2025 Compulsory examination session.
instructions: Part-I (MCQs) is compulsory and carries 20 marks (30 minutes).
Part-II contains seven subjective questions; attempt any FOUR questions (20 marks each).
Credit will be given for analytical depth, original reasoning, and accurate constitutional references.

sections.title: Part-I: 20 Objective MCQs (20 Marks)
sections.instructions: Attempt all 20 MCQs in the first 30 minutes on the computer-readable OMR sheet.
questions: Constitutional analysis of Council of Common Interests (CCI) under Article 153.
Chronology of 19th Constitutional Amendment and judicial appointments.
The Indus Waters Treaty provisions governing western tributaries.
Economic indicators and CPEC Phase-II industrial cooperation framework.

sections.title: Part-II: Subjective Analytical Essay Questions (80 Marks)
sections.instructions: Attempt any FOUR questions. All questions carry equal marks (20 Marks each).
questions: Q2: Critically evaluate the evolving geo-economic paradigm of Pakistan foreign policy. How can regional connectivity through CPEC and Gwadar Port alleviate macroeconomic distress?
Q3: Discuss the 18th Constitutional Amendment with specific focus on fiscal federalism and the National Finance Commission (NFC) Award. Have the provinces realized fiscal autonomy?
Q4: The Indus Waters Treaty of 1960 faces unprecedented hydropolitical stress due to climate disruptions and upstream construction. Analyze Pakistan legal safeguards under the treaty.
Q5: Trace the intellectual contribution of Allama Muhammad Iqbal in articulating the Muslim identity in British India with special reference to the 1930 Allahabad Address.
Q6: Digital transformation and civil service reforms in Pakistan: Examine institutional inertia and recommend actionable governance policy interventions.
Q7: Analyze Pakistan diplomatic role in mediating regional reconciliation in South and Central Asia amid changing great-power rivalry.
